template.title: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
template.governing_standard: IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC)

fields.label: Project Sponsor, Jurisdiction & Project Name
fields.description: Sponsor organization, country of operation, and project title.

fields.label: Target DFI Climate Facility / COP31 Program Alignment
fields.description: Links project to DFI's active COP31 facility (e.g., 10by30, Proparco Sustainable Energy, KfW Climate, TSKB Green Loan, Eximbank Green Line).

fields.label: Requested Instrument, Ticket Size (USD) & Tenor
fields.description: Validated against DFI ticket bounds, financing instruments, and project duration.

fields.label: Mandate Fit: Target Geography & Priority Climate Sector
fields.description: Graph-verified check that project country and sector sit inside the DFI's official investment mandate.

fields.label: Avoided Emissions (tCO2e/yr) & Development Impact
fields.description: Quantified avoided GHG emissions, energy access/jobs, and local economic co-benefits.

fields.label: IFC Performance Standards / E&S Screening & Exclusion List Check
fields.description: Confirms zero fossil-fuel exclusion breaches and checks EIA / permitting readiness.

fields.label: Sponsor Financials & Project Economics (Revenue, EBITDA, Capex, IRR)
fields.description: Key financial metrics required by DFI credit underwriters.

fields.label: Blended Finance, De-Risking Guarantees & Technical Assistance Needs
fields.description: Specifies co-investors, first-loss/guarantees, and advisory/TA requests.

fields.label: Principal Transaction Risks & Mitigants
fields.description: Key construction, currency, regulatory, and offtake risks plus mitigation plan.

fields.label: DFI Investment Committee Intake Summary
fields.description: Concise structured investment teaser tailored to this DFI's COP31 mandate.
